headline: Renesas lists a PMIC thesis internship for Python validation frameworks and measurement correlation
fact: Renesas advertised a six-month MSc thesis internship in its new Catania design center, within the Performance Computing Power team. The role researches silicon-validation automation for PMICs, develops laboratory setups and Python validation frameworks and measurement scripts, checks analog/digital/mixed-signal and power IC specifications, and performs data acquisition, statistical analysis and result correlation. This is post-silicon and measurement automation; the posting does not specify RNM or UVM model development. The official page's JobPosting datePosted is August 10, distinct from the July 31 date embedded in requisition 20031633.

sources.title: Renesas Careers: Intern Validation Engineer (20031633)
sources.summary: Official Catania MSc-thesis listing assigns PMIC silicon-validation automation, Python scripts, lab setups and correlation. Embedded JobPosting metadata dates the page August 10, 2026; requisition 20031633_2026-07-31 is a separate date marker.
